verdict.rationale: Browserbase ships autonomous Agents, created from natural-language goals and run on a schedule or on demand, so a reasoning-effort control is a fair question for this product. However, no evidence item documents any setting for agent reasoning effort (low/medium/high). The pause, optimize and scheduling features are different controls and earn no credit here.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can set how much reasoning effort an autonomous agent spends on a data-gathering task (low, medium, high)
